_level_note: Level 1 of the paradigm's four (crafter_gym.levels.LEVELS, the rig's own table): nothing hostile, the four life stats frozen at 9 and hidden, so only lava can kill. The task chain names one of eleven entries at a time (crafter_gym.tasks). rewind_on ["lost"] with rewind_frames 1 is the rig's rollback for this level: a death sends the world back one move and play goes on, as a new episode from that state; it is a phase field rather than a level rule so that a model played on the same env dies as the game says.
_shared_note: The game phase's other fields are common/crafter.json, which all four levels include; the notes that explain them are level 4's (L4.json).

instructions.title: Crafter, level 1
text: Explore the world and try things.
The game itself will show you what works.
The world waits for you: it moves one step each
time you press a button, and not otherwise.
One task at a time is named above the game. Reach
it and the game says so, and names the next one.
Controls (8 buttons):
ARROWS      move
D           interact / attack / collect
S           sleep
W           next menu item
A           do the menu item
The menu holds the ten actions with no button of
their own: place stone, table, furnace, plant, and
make a wood / stone / iron pickaxe or sword. Last
in it is skip task, which puts your current task
off until later. W moves the cursor and shows it
over your character; A performs it. Moving the
cursor also costs a turn.
(press SPACE to start)
